actions.description: Create a manual activity.
actions.name: create-activity

start_date_local.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-07-17T10:00:00Z"

trainer.description: Whether the activity was on a trainer. 0 or 1.

commute.description: Whether the activity was a commute. 0 or 1.

actions.description: Search for popular segments within a bounding box.
actions.name: explore-segments

bounds.description: Bounding box in format lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2. Example: "37.76,-122.51,37.78,-122.45"

activity_type.description: Optional activity type filter. Accepts run or riding.

actions.description: Get the time-series data streams (latlng, distance, altitude, heartrate, etc.) for an activity.
actions.name: get-activity-streams

keys.description: Stream types to request. Valid values: time, latlng, distance, altitude, velocity_smooth, heartrate, cadence, watts, temp, moving, grade_smooth. Defaults to [time, latlng, distance, altitude].

actions.description: Get an activity's heart rate and power zone distribution.
actions.name: get-activity-zones

actions.description: Retrieve an activity
actions.name: get-activity

include_all_efforts.description: Include all segment efforts in the response

actions.description: Get an athlete's recent, year-to-date, and all-time ride/run/swim totals.
actions.name: get-athlete-stats

athlete_id.description: The identifier of the athlete. Must be the authenticated athlete. Example: 943379048

actions.description: Get the authenticated athlete's heart rate and power zones.
actions.name: get-athlete-zones

actions.description: Get authenticated athlete.
actions.name: get-athlete

actions.description: Retrieve a club.
actions.name: get-club

id.description: The identifier of the club. Example: 1

actions.description: Get the distance/altitude/latlng streams for a route.
actions.name: get-route-streams

route_id.description: The identifier of the route. Example: "1"

actions.description: Retrieve a route.
actions.name: get-route

actions.description: Get the distance/altitude/latlng streams for a segment.
actions.name: get-segment-streams

id.description: The identifier of the segment. Example: 432873

keys.description: The types of streams to return. One or more of: distance, altitude, latlng, time, velocity_smooth, heartrate, cadence, watts. Defaults to distance, altitude, and latlng.

actions.description: Retrieve a segment.
actions.name: get-segment

id.description: The identifier of the segment. Example: 432873

actions.description: Check the processing status of an activity file upload.
actions.name: get-upload-status

upload_id.description: The identifier of the upload. Example: "123456789"

actions.description: List the comments on an activity.
actions.name: list-activity-comments

id.description: The identifier of the activity. Example: 19350154255

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

page_size.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 30.

actions.description: List the athletes who gave kudos on an activity.
actions.name: list-activity-kudoers

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

per_page.description: Number of items per page. Default: 30.

actions.description: List the laps of an activity.
actions.name: list-activity-laps

activity_id.description: The identifier of the activity. Example: 19350154255

actions.description: List athlete activities.
actions.name: list-athlete-activities

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number). Omit for the first page.

before.description: Seconds since UNIX epoch. Only return activities before this time.

after.description: Seconds since UNIX epoch. Only return activities after this time.

per_page.description: Number of items per page. Maximum 200.

actions.description: List athlete clubs.
actions.name: list-athlete-clubs

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

per_page.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 30.

actions.description: List athlete routes.
actions.name: list-athlete-routes

id.description: The athlete ID. Must be the authenticated athlete. Example: 943379048

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number). Omit for the first page. Example: "1"

per_page.description: Number of items per page. Maximum 200. Example: 30

actions.description: List a club's administrators.
actions.name: list-club-admins

id.description: The identifier of the club. Example: 1

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number). Omit for the first page.

per_page.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 30.

actions.description: List a club's members.
actions.name: list-club-members

per_page.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 30.

actions.description: List the authenticated athlete's efforts on a segment.
actions.name: list-segment-efforts

segment_id.description: The identifier of the segment. Example: 432873

start_date_local.description: ISO 8601 formatted date time. Filters efforts after this date.

end_date_local.description: ISO 8601 formatted date time. Filters efforts before this date.

per_page.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 30.

actions.description: List the authenticated athlete's starred segments.
actions.name: list-starred-segments

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number). Omit for the first page.

per_page.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 30.

actions.description: Star or unstar a segment for the authenticated athlete.
actions.name: star-segment

id.description: The identifier of the segment to star. Example: 432873

starred.description: If true, star the segment; if false, unstar the segment.

actions.description: Update an activity.
actions.name: update-activity

actions.description: Update athlete profile fields.
actions.name: update-athlete

weight.description: The weight of the athlete in kilograms. Example: 70

syncs.description: Sync the authenticated athlete's starred segments.
syncs.name: starred-segments
